name: Wallpapers
author: Flavio
description: Wallpapers for both looks, Classic and Immersive: a few ready-made pictures here, and your own pictures or silent looping videos from your phone or a link, chosen in Settings, Wallpaper. Needs a Revera build with wallpaper support (1.0.8 with the wallpaper update).
